title: Mediation Authority's Obligation to Conduct Mediation within a Specified Time and Manner

content.scenario: A consumer has filed a complaint with the District Commission, which has referred the matter to mediation. The mediation authority must conduct the mediation within a specified time and manner.
content.outcome: The mediation authority shall conduct the mediation within the time and manner specified under sub-section (3) of Section 79 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, as per the regulations made by the Central Government.

user_queries: What are the obligations of a mediation authority in conducting mediation?
How is the time and manner of mediation determined?
What are the regulations governing mediation under the Consumer Protection Act?
